subject: Catalog security compact delivery — SOC 2, pen test letter, DPA request
messages:
From: Patrick Hernandez <patrick.hernandez@greenleaf.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@greenleaf.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Catalog listing: SOC 2 / pen test letter / DPA

Hi Sean / Kimberly,

We're progressing the Greenleaf catalog review for the co-sell listing and need the security artifacts to complete the external assurance packet. Specifically can you share the following by EOD Friday (2026-06-04):

- SOC 2 Type II attestation (redacted ok)
- Penetration test letter summarizing scope and findings (single-page letter is fine)
- Standard DPA or pointer to an executed DPA document

The marketplace team noted you can provide redacted reports and a signed DPA will be sufficient for the listing gate. If possible, provide canonical filenames and a Drive link or DocuSign for the DPA.

Thanks — Patrick
Patrick Hernandez
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Greenleaf Analytics
pat.hernandez@greenleaf.com

--
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Patrick Hernandez <patrick.hernandez@greenleaf.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Catalog listing: SOC 2 / pen test letter / DPA

Patrick — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver everything on the timeline, with a couple of caveats.

Action plan: 
1) Kimberly will pull the SOC 2 Type II redacted PDF and the pen test letter; she will sanitize any sensitive hostnames and internal IPs.
2) I'll attach the Redwood DPA template and loop in our legal if Greenleaf needs changes.
3) We'll upload artifacts to the Drive folder below and send DocuSign for the DPA if you want an executed copy.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/greenleaf/catalog-evidence/SG-DL-23019

Kimberly — can you confirm which artifacts are safe to share as redacted PDFs vs which require an NDA? Also please produce canonical filenames so Greenleaf can reference them in the marketplace form.

I'll follow up once the files are uploaded.

—Sean Gallagher
Senior Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Patrick Hernandez <patrick.hernandez@greenleaf.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / Pen Test letter / DPA — files for Greenleaf catalog review

Patrick — attaching the artifacts to get you across the marketplace gate. Per Sean's note, the SOC 2 report has been redacted to remove vendor-specific configuration and internal asset lists. The pen test letter is a vendor-signed summary; it includes the overall scope and high-level findings. The DPA is our standard template; if Greenleaf needs edits, please send them to legal@redwood.ai and we can circulate via DocuSign.

Attachments (canonical filenames):
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025-redacted.pdf (redacted financial/host info removed)
- PenTest-Letter-Redwood-2025.pdf (one-page attestation from external pentest firm)
- Redwood-DPA-template.pdf (editable template; not yet executed)

Notes / caveats:
- Full SOC 2 with control narratives is available under NDA; let us know if Greenleaf needs the unredacted copy for internal audit and we'll route the request.
- The pen test letter is scoped to our inference runtime and control plane (C2) — it does not include workload-level CAAS integrations; if the marketplace requires a different scope, tell us which subsystems to include.
- We removed asset-level logs and IP addresses from the pen test PDF; the testing firm can provide a more detailed summary to Greenleaf under an NDA.

Drive location: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/greenleaf/catalog-evidence/SG-DL-23019

If this looks good, Sean — can you confirm we should send DocuSign for the DPA to Patrick and legal@greenleaf.com?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

--
From: Patrick Hernandez <patrick.hernandez@greenleaf.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@greenleaf.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / Pen Test letter / DPA — files for Greenleaf catalog review

Kim / Sean — received, thanks. Files are exactly what's needed for the marketplace intake. A couple quick items before we close out: 

1) Please send DocuSign for the DPA to legal@greenleaf.com and cc me. We prefer executed DPAs in the portal.
2) Could you add an explicit attestation line in the pen test letter that the findings do not include evidence of exfiltration of customer data (simple one-liner is fine)? Our legal team needs that for the listing form.
3) For the SOC 2 file, please include a short filename map in the Drive folder README (e.g., what redactions were applied) so auditors have a reference.

Once we have the executed DPA and the single-line attestation in the pen test letter we'll mark the security gate done and proceed to co-sell enablement.

Thanks,
Patrick Hernandez
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Greenleaf Analytics
pat.hernandez@greenleaf.com
